title: Ukraine's 15-Weapon Strike Damages Four Russian Warships at Novorossiysk, Halts Grain Terminals
detail: President Zelensky confirmed Ukraine used 15 domestically produced missile, aerial-drone, and naval-drone systems — including Palianytsia jet-powered drones, Neptune cruise missiles, and unmanned naval systems — in a coordinated overnight strike on Russia's Novorossiysk naval base, its last major Black Sea Fleet stronghold after Crimea became untenable. Ukraine's General Staff said two Project 11356 frigates (including the Admiral Makarov), a large landing ship, and a corvette sustained damage. The strike also disabled two grain export terminals with a combined 8.5 million ton annual capacity, prompting Russian authorities to declare a state of emergency and cut water service to the port city's 260,000+ residents. Local officials reported 3 killed, including a child, and 24 wounded.

title: Russia Strikes Odesa Fuel Depot and Tanker as Nationwide Barrage Kills 8, Injures 57
detail: Russian forces struck targets across nine Ukrainian regions overnight using Iskander-M ballistic missiles, Kh-31P anti-radiation missiles, Kh-35 cruise missiles, and 138 Shahed-type strike drones (112 intercepted by Ukrainian air defense). In Odesa's port, Russia destroyed a dry cargo ship carrying military equipment and electronic warfare systems, a fuel tanker supplying Ukrainian forces, and struck a fuel depot; Russia's defense ministry claimed it intercepted 502 Ukrainian drones nationwide the same night. Nationwide casualties reached at least 8 killed and 57 injured, including 2 killed and 3 injured when a strike hit an oil tanker truck in Odesa oblast, plus casualties in Kherson, Sumy, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kyiv oblasts.

media.caption: Russian strikes hit a fuel depot and tanker at Odesa port amid a nationwide barrage
